set.body: General native workflow API over StudyCatalog and existing ResponseBlockSource. Compile strict common spatial support across original unit masks, preserving unit/run-qualified mask identities and canonical absolute voxel order. Validate common named space and exact geometry, mask/run membership and explicit grid/read limits before mask access. Read each complete mask in bounded voxel chunks, retaining per-source finite-nonzero/invalid counts and per-unit intersection counts; refuse empty intersections, wrong geometry/time axes/domain and malformed read receipts. JVM adapter uses native NIfTI block sources and explicit staging; no replacement mask files, BOLD payload reads, resampling or zero filling. Expose checked dataset selection for captured units. Verify shared API on JVM and JS with hand-set MNI masks, counting/adversarial readers and coordinate roundtrip; JVM fixtures verify actual MNI headers, compressed masks and file-backed selection. Consumer integration tracked in plsneuro bd-01M1SATY405Q68RVY3N63ENVTB.
set.title: Compile bounded study spatial intersections with source and coverage receipts
